auth.notes: Bearer token is the Gemini API key. Google's documented OpenAI-compatibility layer accepts it as a standard Authorization: Bearer <key> header on this endpoint.

notes: Targets Google's documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint (generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai), not the native Gemini REST/SDK shape -- so it plugs into the same openai-compat adapter as Zhipu/Venice with no new translation code.
Capability flags (tools/vision) below are TRAINING-KNOWLEDGE pending first-party confirmation from this environment's egress-restricted network -- treat as a starting point, not a verified fact.

Pricing could not be first-party-verified from this build environment; both models ship with a null price_per_mtok and price_confidence "unconfirmed" so the cost meter reports Unconfirmed/not-Priced rather than a fabricated $0, and PriceTierFor sorts them tier-2 (unpriced) -- last in cost-preference auto-routing, matching this repo's existing pricing-verification discipline (see openai.json / zhipu.json).
